tools.name: search_parliament
tools.description: Use this when you need to find a European Parliament dossier (legislative or non-legislative procedure), an MEP, a committee, a political group or an EP document by name, topic or reference, and you do not know its id yet. tools.name: list_votes
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what the European Parliament voted on a sitting day, this week, between two dates or on a subject, e.g. "what did Parliament vote today" or "votes on Ukraine in October". Without arguments it returns the latest sitting day; with only a query it searches the last 92 days.

tools.name: get_vote
tools.description: Use this when you need the result of one European Parliament roll-call vote: totals, the split by political group and by country, the dossier it belongs to, and optionally how individual MEPs voted. tools.name: get_dossier
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one European Parliament dossier (procedure): what it is, its type, lead committee, rapporteurs, the steps so far in Parliament, its plenary votes, and the Legislative Observatory summary. tools.name: get_mep
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one Member of the European Parliament: country, political group, committees, how often they vote with their group, where they broke with it, and their recent roll-call votes. tools.name: compare_groups
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to compare how two or three European Parliament political groups voted across recent final votes on texts (amendments left out), e.g. "how often did EPP and S&D vote the same way". Groups: The Left, S&D, Greens/EFA, Renew, EPP, ECR, PfE, ESN.
